origin.description: Drop tags, turn an HTML entity into one character, and count what remains.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Character vector. Missing values are an error.

origin.details: The entity pattern is lowercase names, decimal numeric entities, and lowercase hexadecimal entities. A > that is not a tag closer ends the tag early.

translation.description: The same count. A string returns an int. A list returns a list of ints.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings.

translation.details: Entities use the same lowercase pattern. len() counts code points, which is R's nchar for these strings.
translation.value: An int, or a list of ints.
translation.example: from diffobj import nchar_html print(nchar_html("hello"))
